name: Implement ArchiveScraper.scrape() — real Internet Archive Ad
description: Implement ArchiveScraper.scrape() — real Internet Archive Advanced Search fetch

definition.approach: Implement ArchiveScraper.scrape() — real Internet Archive Advanced Search fetch
key_patterns: No fence contamination — file is clean TypeScript.
ArchiveResult and ScraperConfig interfaces are well-defined and match the scaffold contract.
Rate limiting between requests is correctly implemented using RATE_LIMIT_MS from config.
Error handling is present at both the outer CDX level and per-URL level, with graceful continue on individual failures.
scrape() correctly returns Promise<ArchiveResult[]> and preserves the scaffold signature.
anti_patterns: CDX API returns an array where index 0 is the header row (field names). The loop starts at i=0, so the first iteration destructures the header as if it were data, producing a malformed ArchiveResult. Should start at i=1.

The Wayback availability API response shape is `{ archived_snapshots: { closest: { url, timestamp, status } } }`, not `{ closest: { title, year, description } }`. The code reads `availabilityData.closest` which will always be undefined, so title/year/description will always be empty strings.
